name: pfUI Octo 1.0.0
body:
📁 **THE FOLDER MUST BE CALLED `pfUI`!** If it's called `pfUI-Octo`, `pfUI-octo` or `pfUI-Octo-octo`, **delete the -Octo / -octo part on the end** so it reads exactly `pfUI`. ✅ `Interface\AddOns\pfUI` ❌ `Interface\AddOns\pfUI-Octo-octo`. With the wrong name the game won't load it.

🔌 **ONE-CLICK DLL INSTALLER: ALWAYS THE NEWEST VERSIONS!** It's in the ZIP: after unzipping, double-click `Install pfUI Octo DLLs.bat` in the pfUI folder (game closed). Every run fetches the latest ClassicAPI, SuperWoW, nampower and UnitXP_SP3 releases from their authors' GitHub, installs what's missing and updates what's out of date. It backs up old DLLs and never swaps a newer build you have for an older one.

🐙 **pfUI Octo 1.0.0**: your whole interface in one addon, for OctoWoW (WoW 1.12.1). Made by Bdot89, built on pfUI 5.5.4 by Shagu.

**Download:** `pfUI.zip` below. Unzip it and put the `pfUI` folder in `OctoWoW\Interface\AddOns` (replace an old pfUI folder: your settings are kept). Start the game from OctoLauncher and type `/pfui`.

**What's in it**
- 🗺️ UI layouts: Normal / Raid / PvP or your own, with their own frames, meters, gear and spells, switching by themselves by zone
- 🧍 Unit frames, ⚔️ action bars (14 looks, proc glows), 🎯 Plater-style nameplates
- 📊 Meters (up to 6 windows, full breakdowns) and threat, 💥 combat text, ⏱️ swing timer
- 🛡️ Gear sets with instant swaps, trinket queue, slot buttons, automatic swaps, talent specs at the Goblin Brainwashing Device
- 🎒 Bags with instant sorting, chat, SexyMap-style minimap, loot roll history
- 🧭 Layout mode (`/moveui`): snapping, mirrored guide lines, match sizes, lock frames together, hide frames
- 🎛️ One options window with a live preview on every page, and a pfUI Octo / Blizzard switch per section

**Even better with** SuperWoW, ClassicAPI, nampower and UnitXP_SP3 (all optional). What each adds and how to get them: https://bdot89.github.io/pfUI-Octo/#dlls

Full page with screenshots: https://bdot89.github.io/pfUI-Octo/
